entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit Support, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Ms. Evans. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloPro Carbon cycling shoes. And what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They give me blisters. They just don't fit right.

I'm very sorry to hear that. A good fit is essential. Just to be thorough, did you have a chance to adjust the position of the cleats? Sometimes a small shift can make a world of difference in comfort.
I moved them. It didn't help. I just want a refund.

Understood. No problem at all. Let me just confirm the return eligibility here... Okay, I see they were delivered 69 days ago, and our standard return policy is 90 days. So you are well within the window for a full refund.
Fine. How do I do it?

I've just approved the return in our system and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. All you need to do is box up the cycling shoes and attach that label. Once our warehouse receives them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
And Ms. Evans, I see you're a VIP member with us. I'm genuinely sorry these didn't work out for you. To apologize for the inconvenience, I've added a $25 credit to your account for your next order.
We appreciate your business. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
